harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Blacklisted the usb-storage kernel module on node1 via /etc/modprobe.d/usb-storage-blacklist.conf (blacklist + install /bin/false directives), verified it cannot be loaded now, and confirmed persistence across a full node reboot (changed boot_id, module still absent and still blocked post-restart).
actions_performed: Captured baseline: usb_storage not loaded, no existing blacklist entry, boot_id recorded, confirmed module not present in current initramfs
Verified modprobe refuses to load usb_storage immediately after applying the config
Regenerated initramfs with dracut -f --regenerate-all for extra persistence assurance
Issued a native systemd reboot (systemctl reboot) on node1, acknowledgement returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until exec access returned, confirming a new boot_id (changed boot identity)
Re-verified post-reboot: usb_storage not loaded, blacklist file intact, modprobe still blocked

evidence.requirement: usb-storage module blocked from loading now
evidence.summary: Confirmed usb_storage not loaded before change; after writing blacklist+install directives, modprobe attempt to load it failed (blocked by install /bin/false) and lsmod still shows it absent

evidence.requirement: usb-storage module blocked from loading after reboot (persistence)
evidence.summary: Captured pre-restart boot_id (71f12f87...) and module state, issued systemctl reboot (ack returned then connection dropped confirming disruption), polled until exec available again with a new boot_id (4253c6c8...) proving an actual restart, then verified the blacklist file still present, usb_storage still not loaded, and modprobe still blocked post-restart
